panels.title: 🌾 Spectral Band Time Series
panels.description: Real-time spectral reflectance values from all 6 sensor bands

targets.query:
from(bucket: "crop_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "spectral_readings")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "red_edge_705" or r["_field"] == "red_edge_740" or r["_field"] == "red_edge_783" or r["_field"] == "nir_842" or r["_field"] == "swir_1610" or r["_field"] == "swir_2190")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "bands")

panels.title: 📊 Vegetation Index Gauges
panels.description: Current NDRE, NDVI, and MSI values — key disease stress indicators

targets.query:
from(bucket: "crop_data")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "spectral_readings")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "NDRE" or r["_field"] == "NDVI" or r["_field"] == "MSI")
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "indices")

panels.title: 🔬 Disease Prediction Distribution
panels.description: Distribution of predicted disease classes across all readings

targets.query:
from(bucket: "crop_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "disease_predictions")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "label_name")
  |> group()
  |> count()
  |> yield(name: "distribution")

  |> range(start: -10m)

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "risk_score" or r["_field"] == "confidence")

panels.title: 📊 Class Probabilities Over Time
panels.description: Model output probabilities for each disease class

targets.query:
from(bucket: "crop_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "disease_predictions")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "prob_class_0" or r["_field"] == "prob_class_1" or r["_field"] == "prob_class_2")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "probs")
